courses.title: Round-to-Rectangle Air Duct
courses.objective: Loft an HVAC transition from a 120 × 80 rectangular port to a Ø70 round outlet, add a 90° bend, extend a straight flange, then offset a liner and thicken everything into sheet metal.

steps.title: Three port sections
steps.learn: A transition duct is defined by its two ports plus one in-between shape that controls how fast the corners round off.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch on XY at Z 0: a rounded rectangle 120 × 80 (squarish, closed spline).
At Z 35: a softer shape 100 × 76.
At Z 80: a circle Ø70.
All three curves use 16 points that start on the +X side.
steps.why: Lofts follow the point order. Starting every section at the same place stops the duct twisting.

checkpoint.expected: Three closed curves stacked up the Z axis.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Loft the transition
steps.learn: Loft through the three sections, degree 3.
instructions: NURBS › Loft: pick rectangle, transition and circle in that order, degree 3.
steps.why: The middle section makes the change from square to round gradual, so the air flows smoothly.

checkpoint.expected: A smooth square-to-round duct.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Rebuild a clean net
steps.learn: Rebuild to an even 14 × 8 control net.
instructions: NURBS › Rebuild: 14 × 8, degree 3 × 3.
steps.why: An even net offsets and thickens more reliably.

checkpoint.expected: Same shape, tidier control points.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Bend path
steps.learn: The bend follows a quarter circle of radius 90 from the top of the duct.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch on XZ: a spline through seven points of a quarter circle, centre (90, 80), radius 90.
steps.why: A pipe or sweep needs a path. Starting the path at the outlet centre keeps the bend attached.

checkpoint.expected: A quarter arc rising from the outlet.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Sweep the 90° bend
steps.learn: Pipe a Ø70 circle along the path.
instructions: NURBS › Pipe: path = bend path, radius 35 at both ends, 36 stations.
steps.why: A pipe is a sweep of a circle, so the bend matches the round outlet exactly.

checkpoint.expected: A 90° elbow on top of the transition.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Extend a flange
steps.learn: Extend the rectangular end straight down by 15 mm as its own surface.
instructions: NURBS+ › Extend: duct, edge v0 (first section), 15 mm, linear, merge off.
steps.why: Linear extension continues the tangent, giving a straight collar for the clamp. Keeping it separate lets you thicken or change it on its own.

checkpoint.expected: A straight 15 mm collar below the rectangular port.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Check the transition
steps.learn: Curvature combs show how evenly the corners open up.
instructions: NURBS+ › Comb, then NURBS+ › Zebra.
steps.why: Kinks in the stripes mean noise and pressure loss in a real duct.

checkpoint.expected: Smooth combs and continuous stripes.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Offset a liner
steps.learn: Offset the duct 3 mm inward as a copy, for an insulation liner.
instructions: NURBS+ › Offset+: duct, −3 mm, copy.
steps.why: An offset is exact at every point, so the gap is constant.

checkpoint.expected: A second skin inside the duct.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Thicken into sheet metal
steps.learn: Give the duct, flange and bend a 1.5 mm wall.
instructions: Turn Zebra and Comb off first (NURBS+ › Zebra / Comb).
NURBS › Thicken: duct, flange and bend, 1.5 mm each.
steps.why: Thickened skins are solids you can section, weigh and unfold.

checkpoint.expected: Three solid parts: flange, transition and elbow.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

courses.title: Bathroom Washbasin
courses.objective: Loft a basin bowl down to its drain, build a flat counter deck, join them with a G2 blend, trim a tap hole, check the highlights and thicken it into ceramic.

steps.title: Bowl sections
steps.learn: Five sections from the 220 × 150 rim down to the Ø40 drain.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch on XY at Z 0, −30, −75, −102 and −112.
Rounded ovals: 220×150, 200×132, 150×96, 80×54, then a Ø40 circle.
steps.why: The spacing of the sections sets the bowl shape: steep sides, a soft floor and a round drain.

checkpoint.expected: Five stacked closed curves getting smaller downward.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Loft the bowl
steps.learn: Loft rim to drain, degree 3.
instructions: NURBS › Loft: the five sections from top to bottom.
steps.why: The last section is the drain, so the outlet is already the correct size.

checkpoint.expected: A deep bowl open at the drain.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Counter deck
steps.learn: The deck is a flat ring: an inner oval 250 × 180 and an outer 440 × 300 rectangle, both at Z 15.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch on XY at Z 15: inner oval 250 × 180.
A second sketch at Z 15: outer rounded rectangle 440 × 300.
NURBS › Loft the two curves.
steps.why: Lofting two curves in the same plane gives a flat surface with a hole: an ideal deck.

checkpoint.expected: A flat deck with an oval opening above the bowl.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: G2 blend bowl to deck
steps.learn: The rim of the bowl is 15 mm below the deck. Fill the gap with a curvature-continuous blend.
instructions: NURBS+ › Blend: A = bowl, edge v0 (rim), G2; B = deck, edge v0 (opening), G2; bulge 1.
steps.why: G2 means the curvature flows across the joint, so no hard line appears where the bowl meets the deck.

checkpoint.expected: A soft rolled edge between deck and bowl.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Tap hole outline
steps.learn: A Ø35 tap hole sits on the centre line, 120 mm behind the bowl centre.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch on XY: circle Ø35 at (0, 120).
steps.why: Sketch flat, then project it. The deck is flat, so the hole stays round.

checkpoint.expected: A circle on the deck behind the bowl.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Trim the tap hole
steps.learn: Project the circle along Z and remove what is inside.
instructions: NURBS+ › Trim: deck, tap-hole sketch, +Z, keep outside.
steps.why: Trimming hides the inside region; the deck surface itself is untouched.

checkpoint.expected: A round hole in the deck.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Zebra check
steps.learn: Look at the stripes around the rim.
instructions: NURBS+ › Zebra.
steps.why: Stripes that run smoothly across the blend confirm G2. A kink would show as a reflection break on glazed ceramic.

checkpoint.expected: Continuous stripes from deck to bowl.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Thicken into ceramic
steps.learn: Ceramic basins have a 6 mm wall. Thicken the three surfaces.
instructions: Turn Zebra and Comb off first (NURBS+ › Zebra / Comb).
NURBS › Thicken: bowl 6 mm, blend 6 mm, deck 6 mm.
steps.why: Each skin becomes a solid with the same wall, ready to section and check.

checkpoint.expected: A solid basin with deck and tap hole.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

courses.title: Smartphone Back Cover with Camera Bump
courses.objective: Build a phone back cover: a rolled edge from four lofted sections, a domed back that is tangent to the edge (N-sided fill), a lofted camera bump with a lens window, analysis and a thin shell.

steps.title: Edge sections
steps.learn: Four rounded rectangles define the side wall and how it rolls onto the back.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch on XY: 75 × 155 at Z 0 and Z 5.
steps.why: Two equal sections make a straight wall; the last two shrink and rise to roll the edge.

checkpoint.expected: Four stacked rounded rectangles.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Loft the rolled edge
steps.learn: Loft the four sections.
instructions: NURBS › Loft, degree 3.
steps.why: One surface carries the wall and the roll, so there is no seam to blend.

checkpoint.expected: A rounded frame open at the back.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Domed back (N-sided)
steps.learn: Fill the opening with a fill that follows the tangent of the rolled edge.
instructions: NURBS+ › N-sided: boundary = top edge section, tangent from the rolled edge, strength 0.35.
steps.why: Tangent control (G1) makes the back flow out of the edge with no crease. A low strength keeps the dome shallow.

checkpoint.expected: A gently domed back panel, made of 4 patches meeting in the middle.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Bump sections
steps.learn: The camera island sits top-left at (−16, 56).
instructions: NURBS › Sketch on XY: 28 × 28 rounded square at Z 9, 26 × 26 at Z 10.4, 23 × 23 at Z 11.2, all centred at (−16, 56).
steps.why: Three sections give the bump a soft shoulder instead of a sharp step.

checkpoint.expected: Three small rounded squares above the back.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Loft the bump
steps.learn: Loft the three bump sections.
instructions: NURBS › Loft, degree 3.
steps.why: The lowest section sits slightly inside the back, so the bump has no gap.

checkpoint.expected: A raised camera island.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Bump top with lens window
steps.learn: Instead of a solid top, loft the top section to a Ø14 lens circle in the same plane: a flat ring with the lens opening built in.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch on XY at Z 11.2: circle Ø14 at (−16, 56).
NURBS › Loft: top bump section, then the lens circle.
steps.why: A planar loft between two curves is a clean way to make a face with a hole, with no trim to manage.

checkpoint.expected: A flat top on the bump with a round lens window.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Highlights
steps.learn: Zebra and combs on the whole cover.
instructions: NURBS+ › Zebra and Comb.
steps.why: Stripes should bend smoothly from the side wall onto the back. A break here would be visible on glossy plastic.

checkpoint.expected: Continuous stripes around the edge roll.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Shell the cover
steps.learn: Thicken every surface 1.2 mm: edge, the four back patches, bump and bump top.
instructions: Turn Zebra and Comb off first (NURBS+ › Zebra / Comb).
NURBS › Thicken each surface, 1.2 mm.
steps.why: 1.2 mm is a typical wall for an injection-moulded cover.

checkpoint.expected: Solid cover wall and camera island.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

courses.title: Ergonomic Toothbrush Handle

steps.title: Trim the pocket

steps.title: Rubber insert (N-sided)

steps.title: Offset the insert
steps.learn: Offset the insert 1.5 mm inward as a copy: the hard core under the rubber.
instructions: NURBS+ › Offset+: each insert patch, −1.5 mm, copy.
steps.why: Offset gives the exact rubber thickness everywhere.

NURBS › Thicken: handle 2 mm.

steps.title: Lens base sections

steps.title: Loft the lens base

courses.title: Bicycle Saddle
